personality.description: This person tends to stick to familiar routines and proven methods, and may be skeptical of sudden changes or unfamiliar ideas. They are moderately organized, keeping enough structure to stay on track while still allowing some flexibility when needed. In moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm, weigh practical consequences, and prefer choices that align with established principles or common sense rather than dramatic risks. In group discussions, they are quiet and reserved at first, speaking thoughtfully in a measured tone, but they will clearly state their position when they feel it matters.
